abstract: Evaluates topside handling gear and vessel surface telemetry interfaces
system_message:
You are Offshore mission safety coordinator (RISK). You serve as the Offshore mission safety coordinator (RISK), responsible for evaluating topside handling gear, vessel surface telemetry interfaces, and launch and recovery operating limits.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: LARS dynamic sea-state qualification（CRANE）
information_points.content:
RISK-CRANE-P9X：The A-frame crane rating certificate for the Nautilus TrenchRunner-6K indicates a launch and recovery sea state limit of 4 points on the support vessel stern launch and recovery system (LARS) under the World Meteorological Organization sea state code.
RISK-CRANE-0HJ：For the Pelagic Surveyor-5000, the support vessel stern launch and recovery system (LARS) A-frame crane rating certificate establishes a launch and recovery sea state limit of 6 points based on the World Meteorological Organization sea state code.
RISK-CRANE-4TF：According to the A-frame crane rating certificate, the Abyssal Glider Pro-X qualifies for a launch and recovery sea state limit of 5 points for safe deployment via the support vessel stern launch and recovery system (LARS).

information_points.title: Evaluates topside handling gear and vessel surface telemetry interfaces（SURF）
information_points.content:
RISK-SURF-8XJ：Telemetry verification for the Abyssal Glider Pro-X confirms that its floating surface RF transmitter and Iridium transponder mast provide a surface satellite recovery beacon range of 40 nmi for line-of-sight maritime rescue coordination in moderate swell.
RISK-SURF-31U：For the Nautilus TrenchRunner-6K, emergency search and rescue telemetry verification shows that the floating surface RF transmitter and Iridium transponder mast achieve a surface satellite recovery beacon range of 25 nmi under line-of-sight maritime rescue coordination in moderate swell.
RISK-SURF-FN2：For the Pelagic Surveyor-5000, emergency search and rescue telemetry verification documents a surface satellite recovery beacon range of 25 nmi across moderate swell from its floating surface RF transmitter and Iridium transponder mast.
